'''Klaus Mindrup''' (born 16 May 1964) is a German politician. Born in [[Lienen]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]], he represents the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|SPD]]. Klaus Mindrup has served as a member of the [[Bundestag]] from the state of [[Berlin]] since 2013.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abgeordnetenwatch.de/profile/klaus-mindrup|title=Klaus Mindrup {{!}} Abgeordnetenwatch|website=www.abgeordnetenwatch.de|language=de|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref>

== Life ==
He became member of the bundestag after the [[2013 German federal election]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.spdfraktion.de/abgeordnete/mindrup|title=Klaus Mindrup, MdB|date=2013-09-23|website=SPD-Bundestagsfraktion|language=de|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref> He is a member of the Committee on Construction, Housing, Urban Development and Communities and the Committee on Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/en/committees/a24|title=German Bundestag - Committee on Building, Housing, Urban Development and Local Government|website=German Bundestag|language=en|access-date=2020-03-20}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bundestag.de/en/committees/a16|title=German Bundestag - Committee on the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety|website=German Bundestag|language=en|access-date=2020-03-20|archive-date=26 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201126160557/https://www.bundestag.de/en/committees/a16|url-status=dead}}</ref>
